title: Comparative 3 (as ... as / than)
subtitle: Такой же, как; не такой, как; the same as; than me

theory.text: as … as — «такой же …, как»: Ben is as tall as his father. В отрицании — not as … as (или not so … as): The bus isn't as fast as the train = the train is faster.

items: as much / as many … as: I don't have as much free time as you.
twice / three times as … as: Their flat is twice as big as ours.
just as / nearly as / not nearly as: It's just as good. It isn't nearly as cheap.
as soon as possible, as quickly as I can

theory.text: «Такой же, как» без прилагательного — the same as: My bag is the same as yours. Не путайте с as … as.
Противоположность more — less … than: This task is less difficult than the last one.
Не смешивайте конструкции: as big as, но bigger than (не as bigger as / big than). И «такой же, как» с существительным — the same as, а не the same like.

items.ru: Я не такой высокий, как мой брат.
en: I'm not as tall as my brother.
I'm not so tall as my brother.

items.ru: Этот фильм не такой интересный, как книга.
en: This film isn't as interesting as the book.
This movie isn't as interesting as the book.
This film isn't so interesting as the book.

items.ru: Сегодня не так холодно, как вчера.
en: It isn't as cold today as yesterday.
It isn't as cold today as it was yesterday.
Today isn't as cold as yesterday.

items.ru: Поезд не такой быстрый, как самолёт.
en: The train isn't as fast as the plane.
A train isn't as fast as a plane.

items.ru: Он работает не так усердно, как раньше.
en: He doesn't work as hard as before.
He doesn't work as hard as he used to.
He doesn't work as hard as he did before.

items.ru: Это было не так трудно, как я ожидал.
en: It wasn't as difficult as I expected.
It wasn't as hard as I expected.
It wasn't so difficult as I expected.

items.ru: Он не такой умный, как думает.
en: He isn't as clever as he thinks.
He isn't as smart as he thinks.

items.ru: У меня не так много денег, как у тебя.
en: I don't have as much money as you.
I haven't got as much money as you.
I don't have as much money as you do.
I haven't got as much money as you have.

items.ru: У нас не так много друзей, как у них.
en: We don't have as many friends as them.
We don't have as many friends as they do.
We haven't got as many friends as them.
We haven't got as many friends as they have.

items.ru: Её квартира такая же большая, как наша.
en: Her flat is as big as ours.
Her apartment is as big as ours.

items.ru: Он такого же роста, как я.
en: He's as tall as me.
He's as tall as I am.

items.ru: Ты бегаешь так же быстро, как Ник?
en: Can you run as fast as Nick?
Do you run as fast as Nick?

items.ru: Приходи как можно скорее.
en: Come as soon as possible.
Come as soon as you can.

items.ru: Наш дом в два раза больше их дома.
en: Our house is twice as big as theirs.

items.ru: Билет на поезд стоит в два раза больше, чем на автобус.
en: A train ticket costs twice as much as a bus ticket.
The train ticket costs twice as much as the bus ticket.

items.ru: Я устал так же, как и ты.
en: I'm just as tired as you.
I'm just as tired as you are.
I'm as tired as you.

items.ru: Новый фильм почти такой же хороший, как первый.
en: The new film is nearly as good as the first one.
The new film is almost as good as the first one.
The new movie is nearly as good as the first one.

items.ru: Автобус далеко не такой быстрый, как поезд.
en: The bus isn't nearly as fast as the train.
The bus is nowhere near as fast as the train.

items.ru: Её телефон такой же, как мой.
en: Her phone is the same as mine.

items.ru: Она приехала в то же время, что и я.
en: She arrived at the same time as me.
She arrived at the same time as I did.

items.ru: Твой брат старше меня.
en: Your brother is older than me.
Your brother is older than I am.

items.ru: Она водит машину лучше, чем я.
en: She drives better than me.
She drives better than I do.

items.ru: Сегодня я менее занят, чем вчера.
en: I'm less busy today than yesterday.
I'm less busy today than I was yesterday.
Today I'm less busy than yesterday.

items.ru: Он тратит меньше денег, чем я.
en: He spends less money than me.
He spends less money than I do.
